_comment: Canonical fab-mcp server registry. Single source of truth. The wire-agents.py generator reads this and writes the correct MCP config into each agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini). Edit here, then re-run: python3 scripts/wire-agents.py

freecad.runtime_prereq: Launch FreeCAD GUI -> select 'MCP Addon' workbench -> click 'Start RPC Server'. The uvx server connects to FreeCAD's in-app RPC socket.

blender.runtime_prereq: Launch Blender -> N-panel -> BlenderMCP tab -> click 'Connect to Claude'. Addon listens on localhost:9876.

bambu._enabled_note: Set to true ONLY after filling config/.env with real printer values. Wrong BAMBU_MODEL can crash the bed into the nozzle.
bambu.description: Bambu Lab printer control + slicing (rowbotik/bambu-printer-mcp, a fork of DMontgomery40/bambu-printer-mcp)
bambu.runtime_prereq: Printer: Settings -> Network -> enable LAN Only Mode + Developer Mode. Copy Access Code -> BAMBU_TOKEN. Fill config/.env.
